description: Turn 1 to 128 bytes into a PCM16 WAV audio block using the AI SENSE audio-v1 modem. data is UTF-8 text unless input_encoding is base64. Audible tones are the default. high uses experimental tones from 14.8 to 16.0 kHz and ultrasound experimental tones from 18.5 to 19.7 kHz. Both can be audible and depend on the devices. Play the audio near a listening device, then decode its recording. This encoding is unencrypted. Nothing is stored. No API key, no account and no sign up.

data.description: UTF-8 text or standard Base64 representing at most 128 bytes.

input_encoding.description: utf8 by default. Choose base64 for arbitrary binary bytes.

mode.description: audible by default. high and ultrasound are experimental and depend on the speakers and microphone.

name: encode_audio
title: Encode data as sound
